verdict.rationale: Phoenix docs show traces that record a run step by step, covering model calls, retrieval, tool use and custom logic. Span-level decorators (@tracer.chain, @tracer.tool) and a span query API back this up, and a Sessions feature groups related traces into conversations and multi-turn sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the parent/child span nesting hierarchy for multi-step agent runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of session grouping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Tracing lets you see what happened during a single run of your AI application, step by step. A trace captures model calls, retrieval, tool use, and custom logic
Tracing decorators — @tracer.chain, @tracer.tool, and more for manual instrumentation
Group related traces into conversations and user sessions
